title: Automated Reasoning in Normative Detachment Structures with Ideal Conditions
reasoning: The paper focuses on deontic logic, the formal logic of obligations, permissions, and norms. It explores normative reasoning, specifically addressing 'normative ideality' and 'sub-ideality', and models ethical/legal paradoxes such as Chisholm's paradox. It applies these frameworks to a concrete legal text (UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods).
